description: Scoping questions asked at engagement intake (Slice 109): the common ones for every engagement, plus each requested role family's own. Snapshotted into each engagement at creation.

common.text: What decision will this work inform, and who makes it?
When do you need the result, and is there an earlier checkpoint?
Who will read or use the deliverable (role, level of detail they expect)?
What material can you share (documents, data, prior work), and is any of it confidential?
What is explicitly out of scope?

research-reporting.text: Which companies, markets, policies or topics, which geography and which period?
Any sources to prioritise or to exclude?

consulting.text: What has been tried already, and what do the numbers show today?
What would success look like, and how would you measure it?
What constraints apply (budget, people, timing, appetite for change)?

finance-modeling.text: What must the model answer (valuation, forecast, credit capacity, pricing, scenario)?
Which financials are available, for which periods, in which currency and units?
Any house views or assumptions the model must use?

data-analytics.text: Which datasets or systems hold the data, how can they be shared, and roughly how large are they?
Which metric or question should the analysis answer?

accounting-operations.text: Which ledger or system, which period, and which chart of accounts?
Who approves postings and payments on your side?

risk-audit-controls.text: Which framework, standard or internal policy applies?
Which processes, systems and period are in scope?

financial-crime.text: What kind of alert or case, in which jurisdiction, under which programme or policy?
Who makes the disposition on each case?

legal-contracts-procurement.text: Which documents, and which playbook, positions or template should they be checked against?
Who reviews the output before it is relied on (for legal matters, a lawyer)?

content-communications.text: Approved claims, sources or a brand guide to follow?

people-hr.text: Which process, which systems, and what volume?
Who makes the people decisions this work supports?

software-it.text: Which codebase or system, which language, and how are tests run?
What does done look like (the issue, acceptance criteria)?

insurance.text: Which line of business and jurisdiction, and which policy documents apply?
Which licensed adjuster or underwriter makes the decision?

sales-customer-coordination.text: Which accounts, segment, customers or project?
Who approves outgoing messages and changes in your tools?
